insight: Its functional-music research is NSF-funded and published in Nature Communications (2024); the neural-modulation technique is patented.
name: Brain.fm
tagline: AI-generated functional music engineered to help you focus, relax, and sleep.
description: Brain.fm streams functional music designed with auditory neuroscience to shift the brain into states for focus, relaxation, meditation, or sleep. Rather than curating existing tracks, it generates music combined with a patented modulation technique intended to drive neural phase-locking. The catalog is organized by goal, with a dedicated mode tuned for ADHD attention.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary functional-music engine (human composition plus generative modulation).

edge: Unlike streaming playlists, it generates functional music with patented modulation shown in peer-reviewed trials to support sustained attention.
pros: Modes for focus, sleep, relax, meditate
